claim: Registry row 80 is "the one list of each table's readers" (V11 §3.1 *Readers*, l. 898; E-34; T-V11-1 (b): "0 unlisted stage readers"). This round rewrote its reader cell (l. 1006) and W50's consumer cell (l. 208) to name the crossing table's readers of `structure.stripMarginM` as "S5a and S7" only. The crossing table also runs at VS3. V07 §3.5a (4) (V07 l. 1604–1610), rewritten this round, reads "A palisade meets a raised way by §2.7's crossing table". Under *beneath* (base l. 2628–2631), VS3's trace is "a stretch laid by neither" pull nor cost field, and it "is bent locally, between its nearest points clear of the raised way's under-deck strip", which VS3 computes at `stripMarginM`. Before this round VS3 never bent clear of the strip (pre-round V07 l. 1604–1610), so this read is new. The same cell also omits the village readers V07 §3.5a (5) names (V07 l. 1616–1621: "VS5, VS6 and S10 — no house under the arches. The under-deck strip — … widened each side by `raisedWays.structure.stripMarginM` (V11 §3.24.2)"; V07's settings row l. 609: "read, never copied"). Row 80 lists VS4 only of V07's stages. The registering seats write their stages in (J-V11.85), and T-V11-1 (b) fails an unlisted reader it records, so nothing built changes. A list omitting readers the rule names: MINOR.

W50's consumer cell (l. 208): "§2.7's crossing table at S5a and S7 (`stripMarginM`)" → "§2.7's crossing table at S5a, S7 and VS3, V07 §3.5a (5)'s VS5, VS6 and S10 (`stripMarginM`)".
